contexts.text: Goliath = the pride of their Own intelligence.
Such trust in themselves, like Goliath.

By Goliath, who was a Philistine, and was therefore called uncircumcised, are signified those who are in truths without good; and truths without good are truths falsified, which in themselves are falsities... Hence it is evident what the victory of David over Goliath represented.
